architectureRule: ANAS OS is the single operating system. All domains below are native subsystems; none is a separate OS or authority.

domains.name: constitution
domains.purpose: Highest-order principles, forbidden behaviors and authority boundaries.

domains.name: identity-context
domains.purpose: Stable operator, business, technical and constraint context.

domains.name: business
domains.purpose: Market, customer, validation, value capture, economics and GTM.

domains.name: product
domains.purpose: Problem-to-product definition, scope, UX and lifecycle.

domains.name: agent-execution
domains.purpose: Native agent runtime, skills, harness adapters, orchestration, tool execution and handoffs.

domains.name: engineering
domains.purpose: Architecture, implementation, database, security, testing and deployment standards.

domains.name: ai-engineering
domains.purpose: Models, prompts, RAG, tool use, evaluations, safety and AI economics.

domains.name: project-templates
domains.purpose: Reusable project-class starting points.

domains.name: project
domains.purpose: Project state, tasks, risks, decisions and memory.

domains.name: knowledge
domains.purpose: Durable documentation, patterns, decisions and lessons.

domains.name: operations
domains.purpose: Production operation, reliability, incidents and readiness.

domains.name: growth
domains.purpose: Acquisition, sales, onboarding, retention and growth.

domains.name: finance-cost
domains.purpose: Revenue, COGS, AI/infrastructure spend, margins and budgets.

domains.name: legal-compliance
domains.purpose: Contracts, privacy, licensing, IP and regulated-domain obligations.

domains.name: release
domains.purpose: Versioning, rollout, rollback and post-release verification.

domains.name: observability
domains.purpose: Logs, metrics, traces, alerts, audit and telemetry.

domains.name: evaluation
domains.purpose: Business, product, engineering and AI outcome evaluation.

domains.name: failure-recovery
domains.purpose: Failure classification, remediation and recovery.

domains.name: command-center
domains.purpose: Trusted system-state aggregation contracts; presentation UI is intentionally out of core.

domains.name: data
domains.purpose: Data meaning, ownership, quality, governance and lifecycle.

domains.name: research-intelligence
domains.purpose: Market, technology, business, competitive, regulatory and local intelligence.

domains.name: customer
domains.purpose: Customer profiles, journey, feedback, health and voice of customer.

domains.name: integration
domains.purpose: External APIs, OAuth, webhooks, events, reliability and provider dependencies.

domains.name: developer-experience
domains.purpose: Fast, consistent and reliable development workflow.

domains.name: security-operations
domains.purpose: Continuous security monitoring, access and incident response.

domains.name: communication
domains.purpose: Internal, customer, sales and system communication.

domains.name: asset-content
domains.purpose: Brand, sales, marketing, education and documentation assets.

domains.name: portfolio
domains.purpose: Capital, time, attention and product portfolio allocation.

domains.name: experimentation
domains.purpose: Hypothesis-driven validation and learning.

domains.name: automation
domains.purpose: Triggers, workflows, agent invocation and bounded automation.

domains.name: environment-infrastructure
domains.purpose: Environments, compute, storage, networking, configuration and scaling.

domains.name: procurement-vendor
domains.purpose: Vendor evaluation, cost, reliability, lock-in and exit planning.

domains.name: support-service
domains.purpose: Support intake, triage, resolution and support intelligence.

domains.name: business-continuity
domains.purpose: Critical assets, backups, recovery objectives and dependency failure.

domains.name: system-governance
domains.purpose: Policy, risk, exceptions, audits, approvals and system change.

domains.name: system-evolution
domains.purpose: Controlled measurement and improvement of ANAS OS itself.
